license: Original Bunkercrew sound design. Distribution only together with Bunkercrew; standalone redistribution and use in other projects are not permitted.
layers: Asynchronous blade-pressure passes, dry electric rotor bearings and narrow hull resonance
loop_method: Integer-period carriers and circular FFT textures, intact rotation to quiet low-derivative cut
